messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: v2 endpoint switch in prod tonight 2025-11-02T22:30Z. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% over 30m, then evaluate for 50% ramp. Default is still v1; clients opt-in with header `x-rw-api-version: 2` or route `/v2/*`.
carla: FYI — v2 changes a small response field: `output` -> `outputs` (now an array). We added a compatibility shim for simple responses but streaming and some structured-tool calls won't be auto-shimmed.
ben: Change window length? We need to email /status and notify enterprise customers pinned to v1. Mobile SDK pinned by default, right?
dan: Correct — default remains v1 for 48h post-rollout unless customers opt-in. We expose per-client pin heuristics in the gateway (can force v1 if repeated schema failures).
jo: oncall here — monitoring checklist: error rate, 95p latency, tokenization errors. Rollback trigger proposal: 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 200ms over baseline. If triggered, run `scripts/rollback_v2.sh` to pin traffic back to v1.
alice: Confirming Dedicated customers with explicit v1 pins are unaffected. Only shared-hosted routes are in the initial rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary stage -> 5%. Job: `deploy --route=shared-api --variant=v2 --canary=5 --id=1972468000`.
devops: No DB or schema migrations. Observability: added tags `feature=v2-rollout`, `rollout_id=1972468000`. Metrics: per-route token cost and per-client error labels enabled.
carla: I'll update release notes and the migrations doc (`/docs/api/v2-migration.md`). Also adding a quick note in Console under the API routes panel about the header gate.
ben: Can we add a short heuristic: if a client returns 3 schema errors in 15m auto-pin them to v1 and alert owners? That would reduce breakage for noisy clients.
dan: Good idea — gateway already supports auto-pin rules. I can flip on a temporary rule for the next 72h: `auto_pin_on_schema_failures=3:15m`.
jo: I'll be watching alerts and have rollback playbook ready. ping me if canary hits 10% or if error spikes.
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% complete — no anomaly windows detected in the last 10m. Next scheduled ramp to 20% in +15m unless a rollback is triggered. /cc @carla @jo @ben :thumbsup:
carla: Noted. I'll also post a summary to #announcements with the short migration steps and link to the docs.
devops: Added a console banner for affected routes: "v2 rollout in progress — opt-in with `x-rw-api-version: 2`." Also instrumented sample rate for request bodies to catch bad clients.
ben: Ping me at 20% and 50% so we can update external release notes and customer comms.
deploy-bot: Canary at 20% stable at 1972468923. No rollout blockers. Next ramp pending in 15m.
